title: Private Raku Parties
source_quote:
PRIVATE RAKU PARTIES
TIAC's raku firing experience is designed to give you a feel for that ancient process. Bisque fired pieces will be available to choose from and you'll then glaze the pieces you've chosen before they go into the outdoor kiln to be fired.
evidence_sentence: Private raku parties involve glazing bisque-fired pieces and firing them in the outdoor kiln.
evidence_quote:

summary: Book a private raku party where you select bisque-fired pieces, glaze them, and watch them fire in the outdoor kiln. Bring snacks and drinks to enjoy during the firing.
how_to_join: Call Kathy at 315-686-4123 x205 or stop by the pottery studio for pricing and booking.
